bio: Montréal through the seasons: alley murals, snowy staircases, Mile End mornings. Shot on foot, never rushed.
avatar: Portrait of a man in his early 30s with short dark hair and a light stubble, wool coat and scarf, warm winter street light behind him, soft smile, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic view of a snowy Montréal street at dusk with outdoor spiral staircases and warm lit windows, a soft band of subject across the middle, cinematic photograph

collections.title: Montréal, four seasons
collections.description: Short walks through the city as it changes.
videos: Spiral staircase in the first snow
Mile End alley mural at sunrise

videos.title: Spiral staircase in the first snow
videos.description: The iconic outdoor staircases of the Plateau, white with the first snow of the year, one slow look up the steps.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a wrought-iron outdoor spiral staircase on a Montréal brick duplex covered with fresh snow, blue hour, warm window light, no people, no text
videos.motion: Snowflakes drift down gently, the camera slowly tilts up the staircase, window lights glow warmly, subtle natural motion.

videos.title: Mile End alley mural at sunrise
videos.description: A back-alley mural waking up with the morning light, steam from a vent, a cyclist passing far away.
videos.still: Wide cinematic photograph of a colourful abstract mural on a brick alley wall in Montréal at sunrise, steam rising from a street vent, a distant cyclist, no text, no lettering
videos.motion: Slow push forward along the alley, steam drifts across, the distant cyclist rides slowly away, golden light grows.

videos.title: Metro platform, last train
videos.description: Late evening on a quiet Montréal metro platform: tiles, reflections and the train sliding in.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of an empty Montréal metro platform at night, glossy tiles reflecting ceiling lights, a train arriving blurred, a lone commuter far away seen from behind, no text
videos.motion: The train glides into the platform, reflections slide across the tiles, the commuter stands still, slow camera drift.

videos.title: Marché Jean-Talon in late October
videos.description: Pumpkins, apples and last tomatoes at the market stalls, a grey autumn light and warm coats.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a farmers market in autumn in Montréal, stalls stacked with pumpkins apples and squash, people in warm coats seen from a distance, soft overcast light, no text, no signage lettering
videos.motion: Slow gentle pan across the stalls, people move slowly in the background, leaves blow past, natural handheld feel.

stories.caption: First snow on the Plateau
stories.still: Vertical photograph of snow falling on a Montréal street with parked cars and glowing streetlights at dusk, no text

stories.caption: Bagels still warm
stories.still: Vertical close-up photograph of a paper bag of fresh sesame bagels on a wooden counter, steam rising, warm bakery light, no text

stories.caption: Mont Royal from the lookout
stories.still: Vertical photograph of the Montréal skyline from the Mont Royal lookout in autumn colours at sunset, no text
stories.motion: Clouds drift, city lights start to appear, slow subtle push-in.
